scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:setup: docker compose up -d && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run wait-for-db && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run seed
scripts.dev:live: node scripts/check-live-env.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
